scope: Source verification for four direct runtime packages whose installed archives did not include a standalone license file. This record does not replace upstream license text, audit transitive dependencies, or grant rights to authored assets.

localEvidence.observedInstalledTextStatus: not-packaged for all four packages at inspection
localEvidence.mutationBoundary: The two pinned original MIT files were added as persistent supplements; the existing prepare script now verifies and copies them offline. Generated notices identify their upstream origin. No package, lockfile, runtime source or upstream legal wording was modified.

method: Read installed package metadata and generated package notices.
Browse upstream repository and official license pages.
Resolve matching release tags with git ls-remote; use the npm publisher's gitHead only where a matching tag was unavailable.
Fetch upstream files at immutable commits, verify matching package version, and calculate SHA-256 over original response bytes.
Inspect recursive upstream trees and README when no standalone license file was found.

packages.name: @react-three/fiber
packages.evaluatedScope: The repository license applies to the React renderer source at the matching package release; Three.js, Drei and authored assets retain their own licenses.
packages.redistributionGuidance: Preserve the original copyright and permission notice with copies or substantial portions. Copy the original pinned bytes if supplementing generated notices; do not synthesize a replacement license.
packages.remaining: No missing runtime license text for this inspected direct package; transitive and asset licenses remain separate.

packages.name: @rive-app/canvas
packages.evaluatedScope: The JavaScript/WASM runtime repository at the matching package release. This verification does not license the Rive editor, .riv artwork, fonts, images or other embedded assets.
packages.redistributionGuidance: Preserve the original MIT copyright and permission notice. Keep asset provenance separate from runtime licensing.
packages.remaining: No missing runtime license text for this inspected direct package; transitive and asset licenses remain separate.

packages.name: gsap
packages.evaluatedScope: Runtime use in preauthored web demonstrations. No claim is made that the standard license permits a competing visual animation authoring product.
decisionRelevantTerms: The official FAQ includes commercial use under the standard no-charge license; it is not an MIT or unrestricted open-source license.
The terms restrict specified visual animation building tools competing with Webflow's animation-building capabilities and restrict removal or alteration of proprietary notices.
The official FAQ says AI-generated GSAP code is not itself prohibited use.
packages.redistributionGuidance: Keep the installed code notices and exact official terms link. Do not fabricate a standalone LICENSE or relabel the package MIT. The pinned release README links to mutable website terms, so record the verification date.
packages.remaining: No original standalone legal-text file exists in the inspected release tree. This bounded task verified the official linked terms but did not copy or modify the website's legal text.

packages.name: split-type
packages.commitResolution: npm view split-type@0.3.4 gitHead --json; no matching 0.3.4 tag was returned by git ls-remote --tags
packages.evaluatedScope: The installed package and publisher-mapped source commit both declare ISC. This establishes the declaration; it does not supply missing project-specific copyright and license text.
packages.redistributionGuidance: Retain the publisher metadata and source links. Do not manufacture an ISC file or infer a copyright year from author metadata.
packages.remaining: The upstream original license text or maintainer clarification is still unavailable from the inspected package, commit tree and README.

integrationBoundary: scripts/prepare-technology-assets.mjs reads this record for version-matched supplemental source paths and hashes. Generated notices distinguish packaged text, upstream original supplements and link-only declarations. Builds do not fetch remote license text.
